title: Good company, wrong segment: medical imaging equipment

input.facts: Ultrasound and point-of-care imaging systems for hospitals. Service contracts are 40% of sales. The share price fell 33% after a delayed hospital tender cycle in the UK that management expects to resume. Leverage 1.8x. No large holder. No regulatory issue.

why: Imaging is outside the in-vitro diagnostics segments of the thesis: Watch. Not Reject (no kill criterion) and not Fit (a thesis criterion is not met).
